Step 1: Start date 1455-12-25.  
Step 2: 11 weeks + 6 days = 11×7 + 6 = 83 days.  
Step 3: 1455-12-25 + 83 days:  
Dec 25 → Dec 31 = 6 days (remain 77 days).  
Jan 1456 is leap year (divisible by 4, Julian calendar rule).  
Jan 31 days → 77 - 31 = 46 left.  
Feb 29 days (leap) → 46 - 29 = 17 left.  
Mar 17 → 1456-03-17.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1456-03-17
